images.alt: Черные керамические сосуды барро-негро в мастерской Койотепека — иллюстрация
images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: wide 16:9 premium travel website hero, photorealistic editorial illustration grounded in the place, natural textures and light, composition with calm uncluttered left side for white title. No words, logos, watermark, collage, frame or inset. San Bartolo Coyotepec Oaxaca Mexico traditional barro negro pottery workshop. Elegant black fired clay vessels, spherical cutwork lantern and vase with burnished gleam, natural handmade variations and fine incised patterns on rustic wood table at right. Matte unfinished clay piece and quartz burnishing stone nearby. Warm adobe wall with doorway toward a small rural patio. Natural side lighting to show dark clay surface, no metallic or plastic black objects.
